title: EVERGREEN Learning Loom
page0: Create a free Project Pulse system that continuously generates genuinely useful educational content from the deep concepts used across MOOR, teaches those ideas across every field they touch, promotes personal growth and creative transfer, naturally earns return use and referrals through usefulness rather than pressure, and creates a lawful path for explicitly contributed user insight to improve future MOOR learning systems.
correctedQuestion: How can Pulse turn MOOR's deepest reusable ideas into a free, source-backed learning engine that helps people understand, remember, transfer, build with, teach and voluntarily share those ideas—while preserving user agency and making contributed learning data explicit, provenance-rich and separable from private input?
objective: Make MOOR's architecture itself a public learning substrate: every durable concept can become a learning thread, every learning thread can produce a real experiment/build/reflection, every useful learner contribution can become an explicitly consented evidence capsule, and the resulting knowledge can compound without turning education into covert behavioral manipulation.

existingMachinery.use: Endless MOOR canon speaker; retain as ambient format, not curriculum authority.
Public learning world / Reading Hall / Amphitheater / Makers Hall destination.
Reference graph, learning records, failures, artifacts and MOOR output ingestion.

materialQuestions: What deep MOOR concepts are general enough to improve a learner's thinking outside MOOR?
What fields does each concept touch, and what changes when the concept is translated into those fields?
What content structure most reliably creates understanding, retrieval, transfer and action rather than passive consumption?
How should the system generate useful variation without inventing unsupported claims or losing source provenance?
What makes a learner want to return because the system is useful, not because attention is being covertly manipulated?
What outputs are naturally worth sharing with another person without an artificial referral pitch?
What learner input may stay private, what may personalize local learning, and what may be explicitly contributed to MOOR improvement?
How should contributed insight retain consent scope, provenance and withdrawal/supersession metadata?
How does learning output flow back into Pulse as artifacts/evidence without silently becoming canonical law?
How can the same learning machinery appear in Pulse, LECTURE and EVERGREEN without duplicating curriculum authority?
laws: Education is the product; retention and referral are consequences of demonstrated value.
No dark patterns, disguised persuasion, hidden referral prompts, false urgency, streak punishment, or exploitation of lowered attention/guard.
Return prompts must be tied to learner-chosen goals, spaced retrieval, unfinished builds or previously useful concepts.
Referral asks appear only after value-producing actions and remain optional, dismissible and honest.
Every generated thread distinguishes source-backed MOOR claims, general analogies, exercises and learner interpretation.
The learner must do something: recall, explain, compare, experiment, build, critique or teach.
Cross-field transfer is required; a concept should be tested in multiple domains rather than memorized as MOOR jargon.
Raw user input is private/local by default and is not training-eligible merely because it exists.
Contribution to MOOR improvement requires an explicit action and a ContributionCapsule recording consent scope and provenance.
Contribution capsules are evidence/candidates, not canonical truth.
Sensitive/private context is excluded from generalized training contribution by default.
The system must support free public learning without requiring referral, account growth or payment.

retention: Review queue is based on prior completed threads and spaced retrieval, not endless novelty.
Saved projects/challenges create a reason to return.
Progress measures concepts applied and recalled, not screen time.
Daily thread is deterministic and finite; there is no requirement to keep scrolling.
referral: After a learner creates something useful, offer an optional shareable artifact containing the concept, challenge and their output.
Teach-back prompts make another person part of learning itself.
Collaborative challenges invite co-building rather than referral-code solicitation.
Shared artifacts retain MOOR/source provenance so useful ideas naturally carry origin.
prohibited: prompts timed to lowered guard or fatigue

scopes.meaning: Stored on this device for the learner. Never training-eligible.
Explicitly emit a distilled ContributionCapsule into Pulse as candidate learning evidence.
Explicitly mark a contribution suitable for public/remix learning artifacts; still retains provenance.

contributionModel.law: No background collection. A learner must explicitly press a contribution action after seeing the exact text/scope being contributed.

architecture.sourceLayer: Built-in concept registry plus current Pulse source/reference packet when available.
architecture.localState: localStorage progress, review schedule, private journal and saved artifacts.
architecture.pulseOutput: Same-origin moor:output messages for completed learning artifacts and explicitly contributed capsules only.
futureDestinations: LECTURE can consume generated source-backed thread excerpts.
EVERGREEN Reading Hall/Amphitheater can open Learning Loom threads.
Wonder Feed may later render learning experiments as inspiration artifacts.

implementationSlices.name: Working Learning Loom in Pulse
scope: Ship initial deep-concept registry spanning MOOR and adjacent disciplines.
Implement cross-field bridges, experiments, builds, retrieval prompts and teach-back.
Implement finite daily thread and explicit next-thread generation.
Implement local progress and spaced-review schedule.
Implement private journal and explicit ContributionCapsule export into Pulse.
Register the component in Pulse and manifest.
Add focused verification and Ultra Funnel receipt run.

implementationSlices.name: Reference-driven curriculum expansion
scope: Mine verified Pulse references/capability graph into candidate concepts.
Require source provenance and human/Funnel review before curriculum promotion.

implementationSlices.name: EVERGREEN + LECTURE distribution
scope: Amphitheater lectures generated from approved threads.
Makers Hall challenges bound to Learning Loom.

acceptance: Ultra Funnel emits valid BlueprintReceipt and ExecutionReceipt for LL-01.
Same seed + concept + depth produces the same thread.
Every thread contains source refs, cross-field transfer, action, retrieval and teach-back.
Daily learning is finite rather than an automatic infinite feed.
Review scheduling produces later retrieval dates after completion.
Share artifact is optional and only generated by an explicit user action.
Private journal data is never emitted to Pulse.
ContributionCapsule requires explicit non-private consent scope and records training eligibility/provenance.
Pulse receives only completed learning artifacts or explicitly contributed capsules.
The component is discoverable and openable from Project Pulse.
Existing Pulse checks remain unaffected or failures are shown to be pre-existing.
rollback: LL-01 is additive. Remove the Learning Loom page/core/component registration/manifest entry/workflow and restore the previous Pulse release marker; existing LECTURE, EVERGREEN, Pulse Spine, Refinery and training data remain unchanged.
